artifacts.notes: Entire 1,135-page PDF text layer retained; PDF is 6,494,239 bytes. Text begins at First Part preface, includes Books I–XXXV and closes with the final confession; completeness is bounded to that download, which does not include the separate dedicatory Epistle. Index states: this project is ongoing, in time it is hoped that all the notes will also be added. Only II.10.16–11.19 and III.3.3–6.8 were read for adopted arguments, with adjacent historical context. Source transcription and extraction errors are not silently corrected.
artifacts.rights_basis: The nineteenth-century Library of Fathers English translation identified by the host as Oxford 1844 is public domain in the United States by publication date. This derivative retains the historical translation and its notes, stripped of the PDF formatting; Triptych claims no right in the underlying wording.
